flags.reason: misreads-source: alwaysPresent=false implies the title can be absent, but the guide says that without a value "title and subtitle fall back to the words Title and Subtitle". The evidence also says there is "no way to hide either", and its Limits say not to imply the title can be hidden.
misreads-source: alwaysPresent=false implies the subtitle can be left out, but the guide says it falls back to the word "Subtitle". The evidence says it can't be hidden.

misreads-source: The why is the Do's caption ("disableTruncation shows all of it, and the card grows."), not the reason to avoid singleLine. The guide's reason for the Don't is "The title runs past both edges of the card."

notes: The type facts /facts/props/4 and /facts/props/5 say "Pass '' or null to hide the line", but the evidence says "undefined brings the placeholder back; there is no way to hide either", and its Limits forbid implying the title or subtitle can be hidden. The content rules themselves don't claim this, but whoever owns the facts layer should reconcile the type descriptions with the evidence.
